title.zh: 粒子与物态 · 热闹程度即温度
title.en: Particles & States · Temperature Is How Wildly They Move

desc.zh: 把物质放大到一颗颗粒子：挤在一起原地抖的是固体，松开能流动的是液体，满屋乱飞的是气体。加热就是让粒子动得更野——温度不是另一样东西，它就是粒子平均动得有多快。升温到熔点、沸点还会各卡一段平台。
desc.en: Zoom into matter as individual particles: packed and jiggling in place is a solid, loosened and flowing is a liquid, flying everywhere is a gas. Heating just makes the particles move more wildly — temperature is not a separate thing, it is how fast they move on average. And at the melting and boiling points, the temperature stalls on a plateau.
